authoritative_for: Cast owns retained company and job identities, extracted discovery evidence, collection coverage and freshness, local query configuration, conservative request-budget accounting, source retry state, consistent JSON exports, and its program packaging.
not_authoritative_for: Publishers and providers own external facts and coverage. Downstream products own personal selection, CRM cases, application packets, application submission and email delivery.

covers: All supported public Cast CLI outcomes for company and job discovery, retained-record inspection and export, configuration and diagnosis, and program installation in this release.
excludes: Help/version display, direct SQLite access, implementation helpers, current remote-provider readiness, scheduled activation, agents, computer use and downstream application work.

shared_access_and_trust: Cast is a current-user local CLI. Its database belongs to the selected private state directory; provider credentials arrive through the process environment. The installed wrapper sources ~/.zshrc and passes only the two provider keys and its documented environment.
shared_privacy_and_retention: Retained state and exports include private search interests, company/job evidence, extracted posting text, source locators and collection history. Ordinary response bodies are transient. API keys do not belong in config, database, command arguments or logs.
compatibility_and_retirement: Cast provider release, capability contract version, database schema and export schema are distinct. Installed bundles change only through a matching product release.
operational_limits: Cast uses ordinary Rust and HTTP with explicit local budgets. It invokes no model, Nucleus, CRM steward, computer-use tool or email sender and installs no schedule. External catalog and job coverage is incomplete.
